page0.text:
"It's good to train, but you should do it in moderation. Jamming a finger is painful enough, but people aren't supposed to nearly break bones during practice."
"Ow...! S-Sakura, can't you wrap the bandage a little slower?"

page1.text: "Of course it hurts, but if I don't do that, it's going to swell! Consider this your just deserts for being so careless."

page2.text:
"Guh...!"
Sakura tapes my middle finger tightly.
She does it skillfully. She probably sees a lot of sprained fingers in the kyudo club.
Still, she could be gentler about it.

page3.text:
"That goes for you too, Saber.
If you're more skilled than Senpai is, shouldn't you be more careful with him? He's bruised all over, so he can't even take a bath."

page4.text:
"Sakura, I should note that Shirou requested this.
All I did was give him the intensity he asked for.
And Shirou, you bear some responsibility for this as well. You should not have asked me to spar with you if you were going to be so unfocused."

page5.text:
Saber looks at me, displeased.
"Oof."
I don't have any excuse for that.

page6.text:
"Huh...? Senpai, are you not feeling well?
...Um, it's not very like you to enter a dojo when you're distracted."

page7.text: "Exactly. What was going through your head? Even with sword in hand, you kept staring off into the distance. I didn't feel any drive from you at all."

page8.text:
"Um, I..."
Sakura was on my mind, but I obviously can't say that. The memory alone is enough to speed up my heart...

page9.text:
"Senpai?
...Does it still hurt somewhere?"
Worried, Sakura leans in slightly.

page10.text:
"...! N-no, I'm fine now! I just have indigestion because I ate too much, so if you'd make me some tea, that would really help!"
I splutter and back away from Sakura.

page11.text:
"All right. I'll make tea, then."
Sakura stands up to go to the kitchen counter.

page12.text:
"(Sigh)"
That almost gave me a heart attack.
The sight of her sleeping in the living room is still burned into my memory, so having her come so close makes me really self-conscious.

page13.text:
"Would you like some too, Saber?"
"Yes. I'll have it warm, please."
Sakura briskly makes us tea.
...I should be used to seeing her from behind, but for some reason, it feels so fresh.

page14.text:
"Argh..."
Damn it, where is my mind going?
Saber's right. I've been acting off for a while.
Just seeing Sakura is enough to remind me of her sleeping form earlier and those soft lips.

page15.text:
...Damn, I'm pathetic.
She's precious family to me, and someone who looks up to me.
Why am I seeing her this way now?

page16.text:
...
......Shit.
I know damn well why.
Sakura's pretty. I've noticed that for a long time.
But, even knowing that, I've tried to interact with her and her alone as her senpai.

page17.text:
I like Sakura.
...Before I knew it, I started taking her presence for granted. It gave me comfort.

page18.text:
Not in a romantic sense, mind you.
I've never wanted to be physically intimate with her.
I know she's a girl, but I wasn't conscious of her as a member of the opposite sex.

page19.text:
Except...
It isn't because I don't think she is...
...but rather, I was just trying not to see her that way.

page21.text:
"Here's your tea."
"O-oh, yeah. Thanks, Sakura."
"You're welcome. Thank you for making dinner."

page22.text:
Sakura smiles happily.
...Mm. Just that is enough to cheer me up.
It seems like she really enjoyed the pork meatballs with grilled vegetables that I made for dinner.

page23.text:
Sakura sets down Saber's cup of tea, then returns to her seat at the table.
Saber accepts the green tea, looking content to have tea after dinner.

page24.text:
"Thank you... How is Taiga doing, by the way? I haven't seen her around lately."
"Huh? Oh, Fuji-nee called earlier and said she won't be coming tonight. I didn't ask for details, but she said she was visiting the hospital."

page25.text:
"I see. She's familiar with your habits, so I was hoping to talk to her about it more.
...I suppose we'll have to postpone you training for now, then."

page26.text: "Mrgh. Are you saying I'm still a beginner after training for the last couple days?"

page27.text:
"Of course. Our training to date has been only to gain an appreciation of what you are physically capable of.
Next, I will think of ways to help you survive using your own abilities."
"Oh. That sounds like it's gonna be...tough."

page28.text: "Yes, you may find the training severe. So far, we have only been warming up."

page29.text:
"Damn..."
R-really?
I don't know whether or not to be grateful to Fuji-nee for not coming over tonight.

page30.text:
"What are you sighing for? This is for your sake—Sakura?"
Saber looks at Sakura.

page31.text:
"Huh?"
I follow her gaze.
Oh, no.
...
Sakura's breathing is labored.

page32.text:
"Sakura...!"
I rush over and grab her by the shoulders.

page33.text:
"Huh...S-Senpai? Is something wrong!?"
"You, stupid! You're pushing yourself without telling us again—"

page34.text:
...Actually, she isn't.
Sakura's shoulders aren't warm, and she doesn't look tired. She just stares up at me, confused."

page35.text:
"Huh? You just looked like you were feeling sick again."
"Ah. No, I'm fine. I just fell asleep for a few seconds."
She chuckles sheepishly.

page36.text: "...Don't scare me like that. I thought your cold came back."

page37.text:
"Sorry. I've been feeling sleepy all day, so my eyes start to close as soon as I relax."
"Yeah, I did see you napping earlier this evening. If you're tired, just go lie down. I'll clean up the rest."
